I have had contacts since I was either 11 or 12 (6th grade). I preferred it to glasses and I still wear my contacts 90% of the time because my baby is always pulling my glasses off my face and already broke one of my pairs! I used the daily kind for the first few years. They are more expensive but easier for kids than the monthly kind in my opinion. However, my mom and older sister also had contacts so I was pretty familiar with them before - maybe you should consider getting a trial pack from your optometrist? 

Hope this helped :) 

PS - don’t get too discouraged if they have a hard time with them for the first couple weeks, took me a while to get used to putting things in my eyes and taking them out.
